narratives.body: LiveScore discusses a reported move for Tresoldi involving AC Milan and Arsenal with a 60 million figure and timing as early as January.
narratives.headline: Tresoldi: transfer reports

narratives.body: 조선일보 reports that AC Milan collapsed 0-3 in the Europa League after Maignan's red card. LiveScore reports that Bournemouth beat AC Milan 3-0, with Maignan seeing red as the Rossoneri imploded on the south coast. TNT Sports notes that Milan forgot to make a substitution after Maignan saw red, with a headline quoting 'Absolutely farcical!'.
narratives.headline: AC Milan: Europa League collapse

narratives.body: LiveScore quotes Pavlovic insisting Milan are on the right track even if too many mistakes were made.
narratives.headline: Pavlovic: team assessment
